title: 第11章 姚谦第12章 时间有点短
lines: 第11章姚谦
晚上七点。
白牧野微笑送别安装工人，回到房间。
看着已经安装好的虚拟仓，兴奋中带着一丝郁闷。
大漂亮则绕着虚拟仓摸摸这看看那，满脸好奇。
两万九千九百九十九！
多可爱的价格，不到三万……
以它蕴含的科技含量来说，倒也不算贵。
初代虚拟仓刚刚推出还未兴起那会，一台功能简陋得可怜的虚拟仓，价格也要几百万！
普通人根本玩不起。
如今已经彻底普及，哪怕是平民百姓，咬咬牙也都买得起。
白哥也买得起，问题是，买完之后又没钱了。
再次恢复到了老头子刚走时候的状态，兜比脸干净。
不过也算值了！
中午那一会儿，白牧野就爱上了虚拟世界。
所以老头子之前不给他买，想想也是有道理的。
这玩意儿真有毒！
否则他哪来那么厉害的画功？
又如何打好一个符篆师的基本功？
毕竟因懒惰贪玩而堕落的人比比皆是。
“大漂亮，你说老头子是不是早就算计好了？”
“算计什么？”
“算好了我从上高中开始，就要有大笔开销，所以才抛下我们跑路了？”
白牧野觉得自己的猜测很有道理，你看这才几天的功夫？
六十多万就进去了！
我是个败家子！
钱如流水那种。
得想点办法赚钱，卖画什么的就算了。
街头艺术家当一次就行。
听说虚拟世界里面有任务发布系统，一会倒是可以去看看。
白牧野一边想，一边坐进虚拟仓。
跟学校的一样，功能完善，自带先进的扫描系统。
精神力二十一点，灵力一百点。
不过这一次，多了关于符篆的信息。
白牧野放学回到家之后，把自己之前画的那些乱七八糟的符篆挑拣几张带在身上，被扫描进了虚拟世界。
敏捷符篆两张、力量符篆一张、迟缓符篆一张、控制符篆一张。
一共五张。
白牧野不是特别满意。
这些符篆，他做过试验，因为目前精神力只有二十一点，所以他画出来的这些符篆，时效有点短。
content_en:
Chapter 11 Yao Qian
7 p.m.
Bai Muye said goodbye to the installation worker with a smile and returned to the room.
Looking at the installed virtual warehouse, I was excited and a little depressed.
The beautiful lady walked around the virtual warehouse, touching here and there, with a curious expression on her face.
Twenty-nine thousand nine hundred and ninety-nine!
What a lovely price, less than 30,000...
Considering the technological content it contains, it is not expensive.
When the first generation of virtual warehouses was just launched and not yet popular, a virtual warehouse with pitiful functions cost several million!
Ordinary people can't afford it.
Now it has become completely popular, even ordinary people can afford it with gritted teeth.
Brother Bai could also afford it, but the problem was that he ran out of money after buying it.
He has returned to the state he was in when the old man left, with a cleaner face than before.
But it’s worth it!
At noon, Bai Muye fell in love with the virtual world.
So it makes sense that the old man didn't buy it for him before.
This stuff is so poisonous!
Otherwise, how could he have such great painting skills?
How to master the basic skills of a talisman seal master?
After all, there are many people who fall because of laziness and playfulness.
"Beautiful, do you think the old man has already planned it?"
"What's the plan?"
"After all, I have to have a lot of expenses since I entered high school, so why did you abandon us and run away?"
Pretty girl: "..."
Bai Muye felt that his guess was reasonable. Do you think it has only taken a few days?
More than 600,000 yuan went in!
I'm a loser!
Money is like running water.
I have to think of some way to make money, just sell paintings or something.
Just be a street artist once.
I heard that there is a mission release system in the virtual world, so you can check it out later.
Bai Muye thought as he sat in the virtual warehouse.
Just like the school's, it has complete functions and comes with an advanced scanning system.
Blackjack of spiritual power, one hundred points of spiritual power.
But this time, there is more information about Fu Zhuan.
After Bai Muye returned home from school, he picked out a few of the messy talismans he had drawn before and took them with him, and they were scanned into the virtual world.
There are two agility talismans, one strength talisman, one slowness talisman, and one control talisman.
Five in total.
Bai Muye was not particularly satisfied.
He had done experiments on these talismans. Because his current mental strength was only blackjack, the talismans he drew were a bit short-lived.
